reason: A host and harness monitoring plugin that exposes runtime metrics and status endpoints, streams alert events, and provides web UI dashboards, notifications, and configurable thresholds.

summaries.zh: 用于查看 DeepSeek Harness 宿主机运行状态的监控插件，提供状态接口、实时事件、告警提示和网页端详情面板。
summaries.en: A DeepSeek Harness monitoring plugin that provides host status APIs, real-time alert events, web dashboards, notifications, and configurable thresholds.

capabilities: Exposes host runtime health, resource, server, API-key-presence, and plugin-inventory data through HTTP endpoints
Streams status snapshots and alert transitions over Server-Sent Events
Displays monitoring badges, charts, details, and alert toasts in the web UI
Allows live tuning of monitoring thresholds and intervals through a settings page
Can send alert-transition notifications to a configured webhook
Can optionally expose LAN IPv4 addresses in status snapshots
